name: Santa Cristina Gherdëina (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Santa Cristina Gherdëina (a brown stag on white above red).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cristina Gherdëina, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Santa Cristina Gherdëina arms — brown stag on white above red
